The proof uses the PROVED corrected FULL source2.15 identity with beta on BOTH residual terms, actual eta constant16 and EXACT forcing interval norms. No reality, noncollapsed gap, assumed spectral comparison or supplied normalization bound is used.

The original singular weak energy identity gives a complex Dirichlet eigenvalue sector bound on the FULL native zero-trace H1 domain and full original dual, including ALL central multiple eigenvalues. Actual intrinsic complex label ordering and an actual valid high source circle then bound EVERY preceding Dirichlet label uniformly in the exact original norm ball.

The ENTIRE arbitrary original spectral weight is retained in the high midpoint estimate: w_n*<n>^(-r)*norm(tau_n-mu_n)<=128*(6*sqrt6+12)*R. ONE cutoff is selected BEFORE BOTH the spectral weight w and EVERY complex physical period-one source q in its ORIGINAL weighted endpoint norm ball. There is no weight, exponent, original mode or original distribution substitution.

The complete actual midpoint sequence, including EVERY finite central index and BOTH original tails, has a bound in the GENUINE original weighted infinity norm on EVERY fixed original weighted norm ball. The actual periodic and Dirichlet labels and all their central algebraic repetitions are retained; the central block is bounded quantitatively, not truncated or assumed locally bounded.
